findings.label: Bare `text-white` in CustomModuleNode blast target badge
findings.description: Line 65 of CustomModuleNode.tsx has `text-white` without a `dark:` prefix on the blast origin badge. This will render invisible white text in light mode. Add `dark:text-white` or use a light-mode adaptive color.

findings.label: Bare `text-white` in UserMenu avatar
findings.description: Line 74 of UserMenu.tsx has `text-white` without a `dark:` prefix on the avatar initials display. This breaks the pattern used throughout the app. Add `dark:text-white` to be consistent with other components.

findings.label: Hardcoded inline styles in Recharts tooltips and edges
findings.description: page.tsx (lines 348-350, 417-419) and graph/page.tsx (lines 179, 237, 279-281) use hardcoded hex colors in inline styles (`backgroundColor: "#0f172a"`, `stroke: "#334155"`, etc.). These don't adapt to light mode. Implement theme-aware color computation by reading the active theme state and conditionally setting colors.
